title: Implement page TeamPage
diff: +  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Publishing the team failed with ${response.status}.`)
+export const formatTeamTitle = (trainerName: string, teamSize: number, maxSlots: number): string =>
+const props = defineProps<{ trainerId: number, maxSlots: number }>()
+if (props.maxSlots < 1) throw new Error("A team needs at least one slot.")
+const title = computed(() => (trainer.value === null ? "" : formatTeamTitle(trainer.value.name, trainer.value.team.length, props.maxSlots)))

segments.title: New TeamPage, TeamSlot, useTrainer, publishTeam and formatTeamTitle, modified main.ts and Trainer

traceDiagram.title: Load and publish team flow diagram
traceDiagram.description: This diagram shows how the team page loads a trainer through `useTrainer()` and renders the team of that trainer. It also shows what happens when the user publishes the team, and how the request reaches the API through `publishTeam()`.

traceNodes.label: Loads one trainer by its id
traceNodes.description: When `teamApp` mounts `TeamPage`, [`TeamPage` calls this composable with a ref of `trainerId`](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L15). The composable [watches the ref](code:src/composables/use-trainer.ts#L8-15) and calls `request()` with `/trainers/1` at once.

blockLabels.label: Keeps the loaded trainer, or `null` before the response
Watches the trainer id and requests the trainer at once
Requests the trainer again each time the id changes

traceNodes.label: Shows the team of one trainer with a Publish button
traceNodes.description: When the page loads, [`main.ts` creates `teamApp` with this component](code:src/main.ts#L6) and `trainerId` 1 and `maxSlots` 6, and [mounts it on `#team`](code:src/main.ts#L9). When the user clicks Publish the team, the handler of the button calls `publishTeam()`.

children.label: Shows the number, name and type of one Pokemon
children.description: When `TeamPage` renders a loaded trainer, [it renders this component](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L41) once for each Pokemon of `trainer.team`.

blockLabels.label: Declares the Pokemon the slot shows

triggerLabels.label: A user clicks Publish the team

blockLabels.label: Names the storage key and reads the props of the page
Throws an error when the team has no slot
Keeps whether the team is being published
Gets the trainer with their team
Reads the id of the trainer last opened from `localStorage`
Builds the heading from the trainer name and the team size
Remembers the trainer id at once and after each change

traceNodes.label: Creates the team app with the team page as its root
traceNodes.description: When the page loads, `main.ts` runs this statement, and [`teamApp.mount("#team")`](code:src/main.ts#L9) renders `TeamPage` with the props it is given.

blockLabels.label: Creates the app with `trainerId` 1 and `maxSlots` 6
Uses `TeamPage` as the root component

traceNodes.label: Sends a POST request that publishes the team
traceNodes.description: When the user clicks Publish the team, the handler of the button [calls `publishTeam(1)`](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L29).

blockLabels.label: Posts to `/api/trainers/1/team/publish`
Throws an error when the response status is not 2xx

traceNodes.label: Writes the trainer name and the filled slots as a heading
traceNodes.description: When `TeamPage` renders a loaded trainer, [its computed `title` calls this function](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L17) with the name of the trainer, the size of the team and `6`.

traceNodes.label: Runs its callback at once and after each change of the trainer id
traceNodes.description: When `TeamPage` runs its setup, [`watch()` reads `props.trainerId`](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L20) and runs the callback at once, because `immediate` is `true`.

blockLabels.label: Reads the trainer id to watch
Runs the callback that stores the trainer id
Asks for a first run without a change

traceNodes.label: Publishes the team and disables the button until the request ends
traceNodes.description: When the user clicks Publish the team, [the button runs `publish()`](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L43), which sets `isPublishing` to `true`, calls `publishTeam(1)` and sets `isPublishing` back to `false`.

blockLabels.label: Publishes the team of the trainer

traceNodes.label: Stores the id of the trainer last opened
traceNodes.description: When `watch()` of `TeamPage` runs, it calls this callback with the trainer id, and [the callback writes `"1"` to `localStorage`](code:src/views/team/TeamPage.vue#L22).

blockLabels.label: Writes `"1"` under `team-builder.last-trainer`
